The protective shield remains effective until it absorbs a total of [%e1.Shield.CoverValue] damage. Chain Skill Level 2 Strengthening Spirit: Rebirth – Strengthening Spirit: Spirit Shield

string.name: STR_SKILL_RA_Dark_ExplosionTrap_G3_DESC
string.body: Uses 4 Tripeed Fruits to set a trap. The trap lasts for [%e1.SummonTrap.SummonTime], and when an enemy comes within 5m of the trap, it explodes, causing damage to enemies within a 10m radius.

string.name: STR_SKILL_RA_Dark_SandstormTrap_G1_DESC
string.body: Uses 3 Tripeed fruits to set up a ranged trap around you. The trap remains effective for [%e1.SummonTrap.SummonTime]. It blinds a target within a 10m radius and lengthens the casting time of its magical skills. While the trap is active, the target gradually loses HP.

string.name: STR_SKILL_RA_Dark_SandstormTrap_G2_DESC
string.body: Uses 5 Tripeed Fruits to set a trap. The trap lasts for [%e1.SummonTrap.SummonTime], and when an enemy comes within 5m of the trap, it explodes, causing blindness, increased casting time, and gradual HP loss to a target within a 10m radius.

string.name: STR_SKILL_RA_Dark_ThornburstTrap_G1_DESC
string.body: Uses 2 Tripeed fruits to set up a trap. Remaining effective for [%e1.SummonTrap.SummonTime], the trap reduces the movement speed of the enemy that approaches within a 5m radius and also causes it to bleed.

string.name: STR_SKILL_RA_Dark_VacuumTrap_G1_DESC
string.body: Uses 9 Tripeed branches to set up a trap. The trap remains effective for [%e1.SummonTrap.SummonTime]. It inflicts magical wind damage on a target within a 5m radius and silences it.

string.name: STR_IDSeal_Boss_Vritra_NormalFire_Abnormal
string.body: Beritra's Mind Control leaves you confused. For [%e2.Deform.RemainTime], all beings surrounding your enemies and you will take significant damage every [%e3.SpellATK.CheckTime]. You can remove altered states by using mental healing magic or potions.

string.name: STR_IDSeal_Boss_Vritra_AreaFire_Abnormal
string.body: The soul is temporarily being controlled by the darkness. You are paralysed as long as your soul is being controlled. You can remove altered states by using mental healing magic or healing potions.

string.name: STR_IDSeal_Boss_Vritra2_NormalFire_Abnormal

string.name: STR_IDSeal_SealGuard_Delay_Abnormal

string.name: STR_IDSeal_Sum_Paralysis_Abnormal

string.name: STR_SKILL_MASTEREVENT_ENCHANTCARE
string.body: [Event] Retention of weapons, armours, accessory boost/upgrade

string.name: STR_SKILL_MASTEREVENT_ENCHANTCARE_DESC
string.body: If the boost/upgrade fails, while the retention effect is active for weapons, armour and accessory boost/upgrade, they will not be destroyed, the level will simply be reduced. If a Noble All-Powerful Enchantment Stone is used, the Enchantment Retention effect will be applied. During an upgrade, feathers and bracelets as well as part of the upgrade equipment are not included in the retention. If the upgrade of an accessory with level 6 or higher fails, the level is not reset to 0 but 6 instead.

string.name: STR_SKILL_MASTEREVENT_ENCHANTCARE_Abnormal
string.body: Retention is active for weapons, armour, accessory boost/upgrade. If the boost/upgrade fails, for as long as this effect lasts they will not be destroyed, the level will simply be reduced. If a Noble All-Powerful Enchantment Stone is used, the Enchantment Retention effect will be applied. During an upgrade, feathers and bracelets as well as part of the upgrade equipment are not included in the retention. If the upgrade of an accessory with level 6 or higher fails, the level is not reset to 0 but 6 instead.
